data.name: Jismat
data.gender_notes: Jismat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'js-m-t', meaning 'grace', 'beauty', 'love'. Jismat is a name for a girl that signifies the gentle, loving, and graceful nature of the Divine. It is a name that carries the blessings and peace of Allah. The name Jismat carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty, Love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jismat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the spiritual journey towards self-realization and enlightenment. Jismat is a name that symbolizes the love and grace of Allah, and the inner peace and tranquility that comes from being in His presence.
data.etymology: Jismat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Beauty, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jismat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
